reserveReview.rationale: Primary disclosures re-opened 2026-10-03: the official website HTML and all shipped script bundles, complete GitBook corpus, official Linktree and its Mirror-to-Paragraph publication archive. The located USDA article dated 2025-10-22 claims every USDA is backed 1:1 by off-chain fiat reserves regularly audited by independent third parties, but names no reserve assets, weights, custodians, auditor, report, report period or reconciliation cadence. Its real-time issuance/circulation/burn visibility is not an assets-versus-liabilities reconciliation. GitBook's internal ledger concerns UCard points and USDT top-ups, not USDA reserves. Preserve the 100% synthetic undisclosed slice and very-high risk; do not turn a broad issuer claim into a measured cash composition or verified audit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: No itemized USDA reserve composition in primary issuer surfaces reviewed 2026-10-03; dated issuer article provides an unverified general off-chain fiat-backing claim only
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve asset identities, weights, obligors, custodians, legal safeguards, liquidity terms, valuation methods, and asset-versus-liability reconciliation remain unknown.
